title: effusiella imraei

It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, pain, and inflammation, thereby making it beneficial for the treatment of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Effusiella imraei include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties, which contribute to its potential in the management of conditions such as arthritis and headaches. The bioactive constituents of Effusiella imraei include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which have been identified to possess antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
